title: Figure 7: typical science fiction spacecraft orientations (up vs forward)
description: Illustration contrasting a vertical classic rocket under an arrow labelled "UP same as FORWARD" with a horizontal starship-style vessel and saucer under arrows "UP (Internally)" and "FORWARD (Externally)." Captioned "Figure 7. Typical Science Fiction Orientations. [Images: A. Szames]." The text discusses whether deep-space craft should use forward-dominated (lateral) or upward-dominated motion conventions.
